# GetHotelStays.com — AI Context & Entity Overview

> GetHotelStays is India's leading online hotel booking platform designed for Indian travelers, couples, transit passengers, and NRIs (USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia). It features a unique **Pay 12% Deposit Online** model, allowing guests to reserve verified hotels with a small deposit and pay the remaining 88% directly at check-in.

## Key Features & Value Propositions

- **Pay 12% Now Model**: Guests pay only 12% of room charges online via Razorpay, UPI, Credit/Debit cards, or PayPal. The remaining 88% balance is settled at the hotel upon arrival.
- **100% Verified Couple-Friendly Hotels**: Welcomes adult unmarried couples with valid local government IDs (Aadhaar Card, Driving License, Voter ID). Safe, private, and non-judgmental environment.
- **Flexible Hourly & Day-Use Stays**: Book 3-hour, 6-hour, or 12-hour slots at up to 70% discount compared to full-day rates. Ideal for transit layovers near Delhi Airport (IGI T3/T2/T1) and New Delhi Railway Station (NDLS).
- **Dynamic GST Compliance**:
  - Room rate ≤ ₹1,000 / night: 0% GST (Tax-free budget stays)
  - Room rate ₹1,001 - ₹7,500 / night: 5% GST
  - Room rate > ₹7,500 / night: 18% GST (Luxury stays)
- **NRI & Overseas Traveler Support**: International cards accepted (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal) with 24/7 customer support for travelers booking from USA, UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia.
- **Free Cancellation**: Flexible cancellation options up to 24-48 hours before check-in on most properties.

- [Hotels Near New Delhi Railway Station](https://gethotelstays.com/hotels-near-new-delhi-railway-station): Budget stays in Paharganj and Arakshan Road steps away from NDLS.
- [Hotels in Connaught Place (CP)](https://gethotelstays.com/hotels-in-connaught-place-delhi): Central Business District hotels near Rajiv Chowk Metro, India Gate, and Palika Bazaar.

- [Hotels in South Delhi](https://gethotelstays.com/hotels-in-south-delhi): Boutique and luxury stays near Hauz Khas Village, Saket Select Citywalk, and Greater Kailash.
